verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas Engine is confirmed open source (MIT-licensed, published on npm and GitHub at playcanvas/engine), so developers can read and modify the full engine source, and the probe confirms the community 'engine is open source' claim. missing for 10: no direct evidence of contributor workflow (PRs merged, forking/build instructions) or independent confirmation that modified forks are commonly used in production, and one community comment notes the appeal is mainly the proprietary editor/collab tool rather than the engine itself.
